messages:
incident-bot: HIGH severity alert — embeddings-inference: error-rate spike > 7% (5m)
Maria: ack. I'm oncall. Paging now. Anyone on embeddings infra? :wave:
Samir: here — saw the spike, looks like a cascade of KV cache misses and retry storms. I'm pulling logs.
Jake: I can run a quick traffic split to the cheaper model variant to reduce pressure. Want me to cut 10%? :thinking_face:
Maria: yes, do 10% cut and keep me posted. Also please mute the alert noise while we investigate — it's spamming the channel.
Jake: doing split now. Command:
```
redwood-cli rollout split --service embeddings-inference --variant lightweight-v1 --percent 10
```
Jake: split applied, traffic now 90/10. Observing QPS drop on heavy nodes.
Samir: logs show a hot shard of KV cache on node pool g4dn-emb. Frequent cache evictions at ~600/s. Autoscaler isn't reacting because pods are CPU-bound in the inference hot path.
Maria: ok, can we scale the pool horizontally for now? Lee, can you bump desired replicas for g4dn-emb by +3?
Lee: on it. Using infra-runbook command:
```
kubectl scale deploy/emb-runtime -n inference --replicas=12
```
Lee: replicas bumped. Monitoring.
Sophie: I'm building a quick dashboard to surface cache miss rate, eviction rate, p95 decode latency, and queue depth. Will post link when ready.
Samir: also created a short-lived Alertmanager silence for this alert for 30m so oncall noise is reduced while we stabilize.
Maria: thanks. Samir, can you paste the silence ID here?
Samir: silence ID: abcd-1234. Command used:
```
alertmanager silence add --match "alertname=EmbeddingsErrorRate" --duration=30m --author Maria --comment "mitigation in progress"
```
Maria: noting customer impact: internal metrics show ~4 customer ingestion jobs failed in last 10m, retries triggered. Raising to support to notify impacted customers if failures persist.
Sophie: dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/embeddings/incident-1841122334
Sophie: adding a temporary drilldown with logs and the autoscaler events.
Jake: the traffic split reduced error-rate to ~3.2% after ~90s. Good signal; let's keep the split in place until postmortem.
Maria: decision log: immediate mitigations = traffic split 10% (Jake), scale +3 replicas (Lee), silence alert 30m (Samir). Owner: Maria (oncall).
Sophie: I'm going to update the runbook section "embeddings alert tuning" with the notes and the new preferred threshold. Will add explicit steps to create silence and to use the lightweight variant for spillover.
runbook-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-alerts | edit by Sophie | diff id: rbr-4567
Sophie: pasted the proposed alert rule change here. Current rule:
```
- alert: EmbeddingsErrorRate
  expr: sum(rate(embeddings_errors_total[1m])) / sum(rate(embeddings_requests_total[1m])) > 0.07
  for: 5m
```
Sophie: propose change to reduce noise by requiring both higher absolute errors and a longer window:
```
- alert: EmbeddingsErrorRate
  expr: (
    sum(rate(embeddings_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(embeddings_requests_total[5m])) > 0.12
    and sum(rate(embeddings_errors_total[5m])) > 5
  )
  for: 10m
```
Samir: +1 on that change. Also adding a tag to the alert for "runbook:embeddings" so routing goes to the right page.
Maria: agree. Sophie, can you open a short RFC / config-change PR for the alert rule and link it here so we can track approval? Put me and Samir as reviewers.
Sophie: created PR: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/alerts/pull/782 — description: "Reduce noise for EmbeddingsErrorRate; add absolute threshold and longer window; tag runbook owner". Assigned Maria, Samir for review.
Lee: noting oncall handoff: my shift ends in 40m. Maria, do you want me to keep the scaled replicas or revert once we confirm stability?
Maria: keep the +3 for now, we'll evaluate in the post-incident review. I'll do a handoff note in the oncall doc when I transfer.
Jake: one more ops tip — add a temporary autoscaler target bump for CPU target from 60% -> 70% in case inference CPU is misunderstood by HPA metrics. I'll file a follow-up task.
Samir: filed TASK: INF-2191 "Review autoscaler CP/target for embeddings pool" — assignee: Jake
Maria: final steps for this thread: (1) Sophie to merge PR and update runbook with exact commands & links; (2) Samir to monitor for 60m and remove silence earlier if stable; (3) Jake to keep traffic split until PR merged; (4) Lee to note handoff in /oncall/notes.
Sophie: will merge after Maria/Samir approve. I added a short-runbook snippet with command examples and the runbook anchor: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-alerts#mitigations
Maria: thanks everyone. I'll post a short incident summary to #incidents channel and kick off the postmortem once we confirm stability. Closing this thread for active paging — keep updates in the runbook page and the PR.
incident-bot: Incident event cleared: embeddings-inference error-rate resolved below threshold for 20m. Autoclear at 1841122448.
